name: Yaki Udon
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / Japanese stir-fry noodle recipes with 250g dry udon (standard 2 adult portions).
Total time conservatively summed from sequential steps: boiling ~6 min + sauté 5 min + 1 min + final stir-fry ~5-8 min allowing for heating/stickiness; rounded.
Worcestershire sauce typically contains anchovies (fish) and is not vegan; also often barley malt (gluten).
No dairy, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, or shellfish ingredients listed.
Cabbage, onion, mushrooms, spring onions, mirin, and sugar are plant-based and compatible with listed diets where marked true.
instructions:
Boil some water in a large saucepan. Add 250ml cold water and the udon noodles. (As they are so thick, adding cold water helps them to cook a little bit slower so the middle cooks through). If using frozen or fresh noodles, cook for 2 mins or until al dente; dried will take longer, about 5-6 mins. Drain and leave in the colander.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil, add the onion and cabbage and sauté for 5 mins until softened. Add the mushrooms and some spring onions, and sauté for 1 more min. Pour in the remaining sesame oil and the noodles. If using cold noodles, let them heat through before adding the ingredients for the sauce – otherwise tip in straight away and keep stir-frying until sticky and piping hot. Sprinkle with the remaining spring onions.

ingredients.name: Udon Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Standard dried udon noodles; cooked weight would be higher but using dry equivalent as listed.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons sesame oil; 1 tbsp ≈ 13.5 g, typical vegetable oil density applied.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion, sliced; typical edible weight 110 g.

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.assumptions: Quarter of a medium cabbage (≈1 kg whole); edible portion after trimming.

ingredients.name: Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: 10 shiitake mushrooms; average fresh mushroom 10 g each, typical package size.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 4 medium spring onions; ≈15 g each trimmed.

ingredients.name: Mirin
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tablespoons mirin; 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g, sweet rice wine.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons soy sauce; 1 tbsp ≈ 15 g, standard sodium type.

ingredients.name: Caster Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon caster sugar; ≈12 g, typical granulated.

ingredients.name: Worcestershire Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce; ≈15 g, standard condiment.
